raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Asset management operations leader with 8+ years of experience in client onboarding, investment reporting, and relationship management across Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan Chase. Managed complex onboarding projects, drove continuous improvement, reduced operational risk and serving as an escalation point for institutional clients and separately managed accounts (SMA) across global markets.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
MiFID II Regulatory Reporting | Fund Performance Reporting | Portfolio Reconciliation | NAV & Attribution Reporting | VBA Macro Automation | Power BI Dashboards | Team Leadership & Mentoring | Stakeholder & Client Management | SLA & Risk Management | People Management | Change Management
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Reporting Tools:
Microsoft Excel (Advanced VBA Macros), Power BI, Bloomberg, Markit, Capital IQ
Automation:
Excel VBA, Python (Pandas, NumPy — data transformation & analysis), SQL
Regulatory:
MiFID II Reporting, Fund Performance Reporting, NAV Reporting, Portfolio Reconciliation
Platforms:
Intelledox, SharePoint, Financial Data Platforms (Bloomberg Terminal)
raw_sections.awards:
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Drove 70% reduction in manual effort by automating recurring reporting workflows using VBA Macros and

Power BI, directly improving turnaround time and enabling team scalability Improved reporting accuracy by 60% through implementation of robust process controls, validation frameworks, and standardized SOPs — significantly reducing client escalations
Prevented SLA breaches across 100+ monthly client deliverables by proactively managing reporting timelines, identifying operational risks early, and implementing escalation protocols
Reduced new hire onboarding time by 25% through structured training programs and comprehensive knowledge transfer frameworks, cutting ramp-up time from 8 to 6 weeks
Successfully managed end-to-end onboarding of 12+ new reporting initiatives including system configuration, SOP creation, stakeholder coordination, and timely delivery aligned with regulatory requirements
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Morgan Stanley Associate — Client & Regulatory Reporting | Team Lead
Bangalore, India Feb 2022 – May 2026 • Led and mentored a team of seven analysts and senior analysts, handling performance reviews, day-to-day coaching, and keeping everyone aligned on priorities. We maintained 100% SLA compliance across 500+ monthly deliverables in an asset management environment.
Owned end-to-end MiFID II and EMIR regulatory reporting for institutional portfolios, served as primary point of escalation for complex discrepancies and exceptions, coordinating resolution with internal teams, vendors, and external counterparties.
Managed client onboarding for 12+ new mandates, working across legal, product, and investment operations from account creation all the way through stakeholder sign-off. Covered system configuration, SOP development, template creation, setting up account in internal systems. Cut average setup time by roughly three weeks per engagement.
Presented monthly KRI/KPI exception reporting and risk analytics decks to senior management, incorporating detailed statistical analysis dashboards to support data-driven decision-making.
Drove systems upgrade and process automation projects in close coordination with global technology and investment operations teams, ensuring minimal disruption to daily client operations. Also supported continuous improvements to policies and operational procedures as part of these initiatives.
Partnered with client managers and relationship teams to produce customised reports, presentations, and due diligence materials (RFIs, DDQs) for institutional clients across global markets.
Built automated reporting workflows using VBA and Power BI, achieving a 70% reduction in manual effort and improving operational scalability across the team.
Goldman Sachs Senior Analyst — Private Wealth Management Reporting
Bangalore, India May 2021 – Jan 2022
Led business-side client onboarding and systems upgrade initiatives on the Intelledox platform, managing project transitions with minimal disruption to Private Wealth Management client services.
Designed client-facing interfaces for streamlined access to account statements and regulatory documents for Private Wealth Management (PWM) accounts, enhancing client experience and compliance adherence. • Developed interactive dashboards to track project status and provided daily progress updates to senior management across cross-functional teams.
Coordinated regulatory mailings and ad-hoc client communications for PWM accounts, ensuring accuracy and strict adherence to compliance timelines and SLA requirements.
JPMorgan Chase & Co. Analyst — Fund Reporting & Operations
Bangalore, India Mar 2020 – May 2021 • Prepared and validated monthly and quarterly fund performance reports, including portfolio analytics, attribution analysis, and NAV-based reporting, ensuring accuracy, data integrity and compliance with institutional client reporting standards across multiple asset classes.
Automated 15+ daily and monthly reports using VBA Macros, reducing manual workload by 70% and improving report delivery speed by approximately 2 business days per cycle.
Served as escalation point for reporting discrepancies, managed daily allocation, validation, and distribution of client reports, ensuring swift resolution within SLA and accurate delivery across institutional client and SMA. • Conducted training sessions for newly onboarded analysts, ensuring smooth knowledge transfer and process continuity
Acuity Knowledge Partners Analyst — Reconciliation & Client Reporting
Bangalore, India Jul 2017 – Mar 2020 • Conducted portfolio and custody reconciliation and anomaly investigation across multiple asset classes
(equities, fixed income), ensuring data accuracy for client reporting and fund-level analysis
Automated the cash reconciliation process using VBA Macros, significantly reducing operational risk from manual processing and improving team scalability; contributed to continuous improvement of processes and controls
Developed error logs, trackers, and comprehensive SOPs to streamline operations and support team scalability
Led end-to-end process transition by mapping workflows from the ground up and creating full documentation frameworks; coordinated daily and weekly client review meetings across regions, managing feedback loops with cross-regional stakeholders
